14 core modules

Everything an SME runs on.

14 items

  • 01Every software customer

    Company & Administration

    • Legal entities, branches, departments, teams and users
    • Currencies, languages, tax settings, numbering and custom fields
    • Role, department, record and field-level permissions with audit history
    • Multi-company and multi-branch without duplicated master data

    Why it's different · Owners configure practical access rules without a developer.

  • 02Almost every SME — especially B2B, services and property

    CRM

    • Leads, contacts, companies, pipelines, activities and follow-ups
    • Email, WhatsApp and website enquiry history with duplicate detection
    • Lead scoring, assignment, decay and lost-reason analysis
    • Source, conversion, pipeline and revenue attribution reports

    Why it's different · One customer timeline — nobody hunts across disconnected screens.

  • 03Trading, distribution, logistics, services, manufacturing

    Sales Management

    • Products, price lists, customer pricing, volume tiers and discount approvals
    • Quotations, revisions, contracts, orders, invoices and returns
    • Commissions, targets and a visual sales lifecycle

    Why it's different · Status and next action are obvious at a glance.

  • 04Every serious SME

    Accounting & Finance

    • Chart of accounts, GL, journals, AR/AP, statements and bank reconciliation
    • Advances, partial payments, credit notes and multicurrency
    • Cost centres, budgets, fixed assets, accruals and consolidation
    • P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance and ageing

    Why it's different · Deterministic double-entry, decimal arithmetic and controlled reversals.

  • 05Businesses with tax and e-invoice obligations

    Tax & e-Invoicing

    • Tax codes, inclusive/exclusive pricing, tax invoices and credit notes
    • Period reporting, reconciliation, exports and audit evidence
    • Structured e-invoices via accredited providers, with status tracking and retries
    • Country requirements delivered as separate localization modules

    Why it's different · Compliance screens explain what's missing and how to fix it.

  • 06Trading, construction, hospitality, facilities

    Procurement

    • Suppliers, purchase requests, approvals, RFQs and comparisons
    • Purchase orders, goods receipts, supplier bills and returns
    • Supplier scoring and contract management

    Why it's different · Request → Approval → RFQ → PO → Receipt → Bill → Payment, without re-typing.

  • 07Retail, distribution, manufacturing, automotive

    Inventory & Warehousing

    • Items, variants, SKUs, barcodes, warehouses, bins, batch, serial and expiry
    • Receipts, transfers, reservations, cycle counts and replenishment
    • Landed cost, valuation, returns and pick-pack-ship

    Why it's different · Mobile scanning and real-time stock truth as standard.

  • 08Most growing SMEs

    HRMS

    • Employee records, contracts, onboarding, offboarding, shifts and leave
    • Identity, permit and visa document tracking with expiry alerts
    • Expenses, performance, goals, training, policies and HR helpdesk
    • Employee self-service portal

    Why it's different · HR as a full lifecycle, not only attendance.

  • 09SMEs that want payroll inside the same system

    Payroll

    • Salary structures, allowances, deductions, overtime and commissions
    • Approvals, payslips, accounting posting and payment tracking
    • Statutory payroll files where applicable, via localization modules

    Why it's different · Calculations are deterministic and independently validated.

  • 10Agencies, consultancies, construction, software

    Project Management

    • Projects, milestones, tasks, dependencies and timesheets
    • Billable time, budgets, expenses and resource allocation
    • Client portal, progress and profitability

    Why it's different · Project work connects directly to billing and margin.

  • 11Every operational customer

    Document Management

    • Customer, supplier and employee documents with versions and permissions
    • Expiry, approvals, secure links, retention and audit trail
    • AI extraction and summarisation

    Why it's different · Documents are linked to the records they belong to.

  • 12Any business with financial controls

    Universal Approval Engine

    • Chains for purchases, discounts, refunds, payments, leave and credit limits
    • Conditional thresholds, routing, escalation and delegation
    • Full approval history

    Why it's different · One approval engine serves every module.

  • 13SMEs with repetitive admin

    Workflow Automation

    • Triggers, conditions, actions, delays, escalations and retries
    • Overdue invoice reminders, lead assignment, stock and licence-expiry alerts
    • Execution history for every run

    Why it's different · Automation is auditable and never bypasses business controls.

  • 14Owners and every department

    Communications & Dashboards

    • WhatsApp Business for enquiries, quotes, payments and owner briefs
    • Unified inbox across WhatsApp, email and website chat
    • Owner Command Center: cash, receivables, profit, approvals and exceptions
    • Department dashboards for sales, finance, HR, inventory and more

    Why it's different · The owner sees the business in one view, on their phone.
